title: Map labelling #2
topic: holiday village · university campus · museum · botanical garden
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The holiday village.
Guide: Welcome to the holiday village. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the tennis courts. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the campfire circle is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the shop. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The games room is directly behind the shop, at the back of the site.
Guide: The bike hire is directly behind the tennis courts, at the back of the site.
Guide: The spa is directly behind the campfire circle, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The university campus.
Guide: Welcome to the university campus. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the canteen. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the health centre. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the sports hall is the first building on your right.
Guide: The language lab is directly behind the sports hall, at the back of the site.
Guide: The art studio is directly behind the canteen, at the back of the site.
Guide: The student union is directly behind the health centre, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The museum.
Guide: Welcome to the museum. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the archive room. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the cinema. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the cafeteria is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The temporary exhibition is directly behind the archive room, at the back of the site.
Guide: The maritime gallery is directly behind the cafeteria, at the back of the site.
Guide: The costume gallery is right next to the maritime gallery, on its left side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the rose garden is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the glasshouse is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the sculpture lawn. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The visitor centre is directly behind the rose garden, at the back of the site.
Guide: The tea room is right next to the visitor centre, on its left side.
Guide: The souvenir stall is right next to the visitor centre, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
